Job Summary Company Name : Godrej & Boyce Mfg. Co. Ltd. Business : Vending Function : Marketing Designation : Manager Location : Mumbai About the Business & Position Overview Godrej Enterprises Group (comprising Godrej & Boyce and its subsidiaries) has a significant presence across diverse consumer and industrial businesses spanning Aerospace, Aviation, Defence, Engines and Motors, Energy, Locks & Security Solutions, Building Materials, Green Building Consulting, Construction and EPC Services, Heavy Engineering, Intralogistics, Tooling, Healthcare Equipment, Consumer Durables, Furniture, Interior Design, Architectural Fittings, IT solutions and Vending Machines Godrej Enterprises Godrej and Boyce manufacturing company Ltd. has made a strategic investment in Urban Electric Power (www.urbanelectricpower.com). Urban Electric Power (UEP) is commercializing a breakthrough Zinc anode battery technology for stationery energy storage applications, originally developed by the City University of New York (CUNY) energy institute. Created from the same environmentally sustainable materials as disposable alkaline batteries, UEP's innovative rechargeable batteries offer a safer, lower-cost, high-performance alternative to lead acid and Li-ion batteries. UEP batteries could play a crucial enabling role in India's energy strategy that leverages renewable resources such as Solar and Wind Job Profile Key Responsibilities

3. Marketing collateral and proposal development
4. Sales Operations, Process, compliance

Identifying customer opportunities for BESS in each quarter c. Own the pre-sales costing and process steps d. Building market intelligence and customer pipeline pipeline (CRM
- Customer Relation Management) e. Participating in trade events in-order to generate the leads and prospects
3. Marketing collateral and proposal development a. Developing potential customer proposals for targeting opportunities b. Planning revenue schedule and ensuring collection of receivables
4. Sales operations, process, compliance a. Planning regular customer meet b. Tracking execution plans and supporting to reduce deviations c. Ensuring collection of residual receivables from direct customers d. Managed customer relationship activities to enhance engagement, satisfaction, and long-term retention. e. Maintaining high customer satisfaction
5. Organizational Imperatives a. Enterprise Risk Management for Key Processes b. Subordinate and Team Development c. Adherence to Compliance and Safe Working Environment d. Ensuring 100% adherence in letter and spirit to organizational processes as instituted by Corporate Functions such as Finance, P&A (including Code of Conduct), Procurement, Legal, etc e. Actively participating and originating Kaizens f. 1. Communication Skills
2. Interpersonal Skills
3. Fast learning
4. Result Orientation
5. Process Orientation
6. Negotiation Skills
7. People management skills Preferred :
1. Understanding of Battery storage technology
2. Pre-sales along with project costing Apply Now

title: Special Process
jobDescription:
Job Summary Company Name : Godrej & Boyce Mfg. Co. Ltd. Business : Aerospace Function : Manufacturing Designation : Special Process Location : Mumbai About the Business & Position Overview With a vision to strengthen India’s indigenous space program, Godrej Enterprises Group began the Aerospace business in
1985. Godrej Aerospace started with developing high precision spacecraft components made of exotic alloys for the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). Since then, the business has been a part of every other Indian space mission. Today, Godrej Aerospace is an integral part of Indian rockets and spacecrafts, including those of the Mangalyaan and Chandrayaan missions. Godrej Aerospace is also a manufacturer of precision and hi-tech aerospace components, assemblies, and systems, executing global aerospace projects as well as partnering with global majors like Honeywell, GE, Rolls-Royce, and Boeing for the manufacture of precision components. The business has executed numerous aerospace projects involving precision machining, precision fabrication, welding and brazing, heat treatment, surface treatment, assembly testing and supply of complex and airworthy systems and has garnered expertise in the successful development of liquid propulsion engines, defence systems, satellite components and assemblies, and dish antennas with feed systems. Job Profile Key Responsibilities
1. Business Growth Leadership
2. Product Process Readiness
3. Production Planning Excellence
4. Resource Management & Compliance Job Description
1. Business Growth Leadership
- Lead the department-s strategic growth initiatives to expand the Rubber and Composite manufacturing portfolio, identify new market opportunities and support revenue growth.
- Provide strong departmental leadership by guiding cross-functional teams, aligning objectives with organizational goals and ensuring high performance, discipline, and accountability.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, understand their technical requirements and ensure timely resolution of concerns to enhance satisfaction and retention, drive expansion in manufacturing through effective team leadership and cross functional coordination.
- Provide technical inputs to the Estimation team for cost, process, and capability assessment.
- Develop yearly operational plans (Resource planning, budgeting).
2. Product Process Readiness
- Lead the department-s New Product Development (NPD) initiatives by driving feasibility studies, prototype development, trials, and validation.
- Oversee process improvement strategy for the department by analysing existing workflows, identifying bottlenecks, reducing waste, and implementing best-practice manufacturing methods.
- Ensure equipment readiness by planning preventive maintenance, coordinating with Maintenance/Engineering teams, and validating machine capability for new and existing products.
- Drive productivity enhancement, cycle-time reduction, and efficiency improvement projects to support departmental KPIs and organizational goals.
- Monitor key NPD and process metrics, review performance with cross-functional teams, and ensure timely execution of improvement projects.
- Strengthen department capability through training, skill development, and adoption of new manufacturing and engineering practices.
3. Production Planning Excellence
- Lead development of new products in line with customer specifications and technical requirements (DRDL, ISRO, Boeing, IAI, HAL etc.).
- Lead and manage end-to-end production operations to ensure safe, efficient and quality-driven output.
- Oversee method engineering, optimize manufacturing processes, and ensure standardised work practices across all production stages.
- Drive accurate production planning, capacity utilisation, scheduling and resource allocation to meet delivery timelines and cost targets.
- Coordinate closely with cross-functional teams including Quality, Maintenance, Design, Supply Chain and Business Development to ensure smooth workflow and issue resolution.
- Implement process excellence initiatives such as lean practices, waste reduction, productivity improvement and continuous improvement projects.
- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and take corrective actions to improve throughput, cycle time, and process reliability.
- Ensure compliance with safety, quality and operational standards while enabling a culture of discipline, accountability and continuous improvement.
4. Resource Management & Compliance
- Lead effective utilization of manpower, materials, machines and tools to ensure uninterrupted operations. Plan capacity, allocate workload, monitor utilisation levels, and optimise resources to support production targets and cost efficiency.
- Build and strengthen relationships with key suppliers to ensure reliable supply of raw materials, consumables, tools and outsourced services.
- Evaluate supplier performance, drive capability improvement, ensure adherence to quality and delivery standards, and support localisation or cost-reduction initiatives where required.
- Oversee inventory planning, material forecasting, reorder levels and coordination with the supply chain to avoid shortages or excess stock.
- Ensure proper storage, handling, and traceability of materials in line with quality and safety guidelines.
- Lead the safety culture within the department by enforcing safety policies, conducting risk assessments, and ensuring all employees follow safe work practices. Support for audits, incident investigations, root-cause analysis, and timely closure of corrective actions.
- Ensure the department complies with all statutory requirements, ISO standards, AS -9100, Nadcap, customer audits, and internal safety regulations.
- Maintain documentation, update SOPs, and implement continuous improvements to strengthen operational safety and compliance.
- Conduct regular training on equipment handling, emergency procedures, and safe operating methods to build a disciplined, safety-first workforce.
- Valuing the information received & effort spent in creating every piece of information. Ensuring the right information is accessed by right individuals. Ensuring Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of information.
- Responsible for controlling the usage of energy sources for Environmental Protection and Energy Security for sustainable growth. Qualification Details Essential Qualification : Degree or Diploma in Engineering Preferred Qualification : Degree or Diploma
- Polymer/Mechanical/Chemical/ Material Science/Aerospace Engineering Experience Details Essential Experience : BE with 10 years or Diploma with 12 years of relevant experience in Rubber and Composites manufacturing. Preferred Experience : Experience in Aerospace industry Special Skills Essential : Behavioral Competencies Required:
1. Effective Communication
2. Decision Making Skills
3. Result Orientation
4. Team Building Functional/Technical Competencies Required:
1. Knowledge of Rubber & Composites technology
2. Knowledge of Tooling used in Rubber and Composite Manufacturing
3. Knowledge of Advanced Composite & their manufacturing process
4. Knowledge of NDT
5. Understanding on international specification & standards
6. Experience of Project Management Preferred :
- Apply Now

Business : Security Solutions Function : Design Designation : Sr. Executive/ Assistant Manager- Design Location : Mumbai About the Business & Position Overview Godrej Security Solutions, since 1902 has been the nation’s first choice when it comes to integrated security solutions for families and institutions. The business manufactures vaults, lockers, and secure room doors for most of the leading public sector and private banks in India and also makes security products for marine and defense sectors. Godrej Security Solutions have provided surveillance installations in over 45 countries, including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Far East Asia, East Africa, USA, Europe and the SAARC countries. Godrej Security Solutions is a full-service security solutions organization, offering a comprehensive suite for residential, industrial, and business premises – providing cutting edge, holistic, integrated surveillance solutions that safeguard not only millions of homes and offices, but also protect prestigious institutions like the Reserve Bank of India, the Taj Mahal and organizations of national importance. 2. Release of drawings, BOM, DXFs, etc
3. Design simulation

- Planning and ensuring development of product as per defined timelines.
- Hands on experience on ERP software like Infor PLM or similar.
- Handling Non-standard enquiries and designing of products as per customer requirement

- Contributing to business initiatives like Kaizen, B-Safe, TPM, GGP and VE. 2. Analytical skills
4. Problem solving skills
3. Team player Apply Now

Business : Motor Solutions Function : Research & Development Designation : Sr. Executive/ Assistant Manager Location : Shindewadi, Pune About the Business & Position Overview Godrej Motor Solutions ensures that the world progresses while ensuring that the planet stays green by manufacturing energy-efficient motors for most of energy-efficient brands of home refrigerators, commercial air conditioners and other special applications in factories. Lawkim Motors was acquired by Godrej in
1977. Since then, the business has pioneered the manufacturing of hermetic compressor motors in India in collaboration with Emerson Electric, USA. Godrej Motors’ Solution manufacturing plant in Shirwal near Pune, India, has been recognised for high productivity and strict safety standards. The manufacturing capabilities have expanded to over 4 million motors a year, including hermetic motors, industrial and commercial motors, and lamination and motor components. Job Profile Key Responsibilities
1. Design and develop specialized electric motors
2. Evolution of Technical specification and project cost proposal for Electrical Motors
3. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering
4. Communication and engagement with stakeholders / Cross Functional Teams
5. Design Validation
6. Benchmarking
7. Integrated Management System(IMS) Documentation
8. Organizational Imperatives Job Description
1. Design and develop specialized electric motors i)Ensuring design of custom-built special purpose motors, IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission) Frame/ NEMA (National Electrical Manufactures Association) frames 1ph/3ph electrical Motors and Specialized application motors (Geared, BLDC (Brushless Direct Current), Actuator, Brake etc.) to meet all the requirements of the product & Customer including Application fitment requirements, reliability, safety, cost competitiveness, legal & statutory requirements & implied requirements. ii)Ensuring micro planning of design and development activities. iii)Participating in design reviews iv)Ensuring involvement in new component development, Prototype making, application testing and post testing design correction for quality maturation. v)Using of appropriate tools like QFD (Quality function deployment), DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effect Analysis), Root cause analysis, DFSS (Design in Six Sigma) in execution of design projects vi)Managing design within the budgets to control material costs vii)Understanding project inputs, requirements and furnishing design documents for new product design and development activities.
2. Evolution of Technical specification and project cost proposal for Electrical Motors i)Deriving motor technical specification based on end application and submit it to customer/ marketing. ii)Ensuring estimation of project costing, tooling investments, Testing and approval costing, Manpower requirement data to new design projects.
3. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering i)Identifying of value engineering opportunity in existing design/ Legacy design. ii)Redesigning motors considering new material, new technology and alternative manufacturing methods to reduce cost with similar or better motor robustness and performance.
4. Communication and engagement with stakeholders/ CFT i)Communicating with the Domestic and Overseas customers, Suppliers related to design project to maintain and provide project related update/ Data as required. ii)Conducting Design review with team, with customer and with cross functional team for timely execution of design projects. iii)Providing decisions for corrections of problem arising during manufacturing / at suppliers.
5. Design Validation 1)Ensuring the required testing is conducted internally to meet the operational and environmental test requirements. ii)Conducting Application tests in coordination with marketing on field to ensure all the motor operational and environmental requirements are met. iii)Conducting endurance tests as applicable to ensure product life cycle requirements are ensured. iv)Coordinating with Electrical / Electronics design team to ensure all the customer requirements are met.
6. Benchmarking i)Benchmarking of competitor electrical motor for construction, fitments, lubrication, electromagnetic and insulation system. ii)Noting down all data and derive right learnings. iii)Doing the required improvements in existing design iv)Ensuring that in new design add additional features as per benchmark without violating IP (Internet Protocol). v)Implementation of the improvements horizontally in applicable areas. vi)Studying and analyzing of benchmark test results. vii)Deriving the co-relation with end application. viii)Formulating the specification for design & development activity as applicable.
7. Integrated Management System (IMS) Documentation i)Fulfilling the IMS documentation for every design project ii)Ensuring departmental IMS documentation preparation and Facing Audits.
8. Organizational Imperatives i)Actively participating and originating Kaizens ii)Actively involving in Business Excellence initiatives iii)Adhere to Compliance and Safe Working Environment Qualification Details Essential Qualification : Degree in Mechanical Engineering Preferred Qualification : Degree in Mechanical Engineering with additional specialization in CAE Experience Details Essential Experience : 2 to 3 years of relevant work experience for Degree in Engineering OR4 to 6 years of relevant work experience for Diploma in Engineering Preferred Experience : 2 to 3 years of relevant work experience for Degree in Engineering OR4 to 6 years of relevant work experience for Diploma in Engineering Special Skills Essential :
1. Knowledge of Electric Motors related to: Construction, Material standards, component and motor manufacturing processes, Design Methodologies and Test Methods.
2. Proven expertise and hands on experience of Electric Motor Design, GD&T and Design tools with analytical skills 3.Experience in Auto CAD / Creo parametric / Solid works 2D and 3D Software.
4. Ability to interact with Customers, Suppliers, key supplier-partners, and CFT team members for working on assigned product portfolios.
5. Strong command on GD&T
6. Understanding of global engineering standards. Preferred :
1. Explicit and clear Mechanical Design knowledge of Electrical Motors.
2. Knowledge of Various machining, Heat treatment, Casting, Moulding, 3D printing, Wire cutting & Punching processes.
3. Knowledge of manufacturing and application requirements of ferrous/ non ferrous, Plastics, sheet metal, rubber, Wiring Harness, Springs and castings. 4.Goal oriented, Self Starter, Flexible to work on challenging projects, Having strong sense of responsibility. And Good analytical skills. Apply Now

jobDescription:
Job Summary Company Name : Godrej & Boyce Mfg. Co. Ltd. Business : Tooling Function : Maintenance Designation : Sr. Officer Location : Vikhroli About the Business & Position Overview In 1935, Godrej Tooling was established. A tool room, that was the most advanced in India for its time. The big idea behind this was to encourage the indigenisation of machine tools. This forward-thinking vision, coupled with the highly skilled expertise of the tool room, were the reasons why Godrej & Boyce got the first order to manufacture satellite components for ISRO. Over the years, Godrej Tooling has retained its position as a key player in the design and manufacture of tools and tooling equipment. The business manufactures custom-built, high-quality tooling that caters to a broad cross-section of players across industries. The business has expertise in industrial machines, pressure dies, casting dies, press dies, die casting dies, thermo-compression moulds, complex and large-sheet metal tooling for auto panels, and progressive dies. Godrej Tooling is a systems-driven organization, eager to learn and experiment keeping abreast of the latest technology platforms, software and manufacturing processes. Its commitment to innovation ensures that even today, the business is among India's most advanced tool rooms, and proudly serve customers such as Honda Cars & Motorcycles, Toyota, Suzuki, Mahindra & Mahindra, Tata Motors, Caparo, and Valeo. Job Profile Key Responsibilities
1. Machine uptime and Zero breakdown.
2. Preventive maintenance and Calibration.
3. Organization Initiatives Job Description The incumbent would be responsible for the following:
1. Machine uptime and Zero breakdown.
- Ensuring machine more than 97% machine uptime & zero breakdown.
- Ensuring zero downtime of machine due to non- availability of spares.
- Carrying out timely preventive maintenance of allotted machines as per schedule.
- Updating PM sheet to include learnings from machine breakdowns to prevent recurrence of same issues.
- Maintaining inventory of spares to ensure timely availability of spares for preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance & time-based maintenance.
- Ordering new spares & following up with Purchase for spares & repairs.
- Identify & execute improvement projects to reduce machine downtime including time required for PM & to reduce maintenance cost including consumables, spares & energy cost.
2. Preventive maintenance and Calibration.
- Ensuring 100% adherence to machine preventive & calibration schedules.
- Analysing the root cause of failure & implementing corrective action through kaizens, to prevent recurrence of problem in future.
- Checking machine levelling & machine geometry as per schedule.
- Planning & carrying out level & geometry correction, if required.
3. Organization Wide Initiatives
- Implementation & Adherence to IMS, Safety & HK Standards & Processes.
- Implementing Kaizen & Improvement Projects to machine downtime & maintenance cost.
- Carryout kaizens to improve the service life of equipment & spares.
- Identifying & eliminating safety hazards on machine & utilities.
- Uploading safety hazards & near miss in system.
- Maintain department & workstation housekeeping Qualification Details Essential Qualification : ITI / NCTVT & Diploma Preferred Qualification : Nil Experience Details Essential Experience : 2 years of work experience for Diploma in Engineering OR 8 years of work experience for ITI with NCTVT OR 10 years of work experience for ITI Preferred Experience : Relevant Experience Special Skills Essential :
1. Ability to understand & interpret mechanical & assembly drawings.
2. Ability to understand & interpret hydraulic & pneumatic circuit drawings.
3. Independently identify & trouble shoot faults on conventional & CNC machines.
4. Must have very good maintenance knowledge of CNC machines, Conventional machines, Mechanical & Hydraulic presses. Preferred :
1. Basic knowledge of electrical & electronics systems on machines.
2. Basic knowledge of Office 365, Infor EAM & Infor LN Apply Now
